# Rust Gotchas

> Known Rust patterns that cause blocking, panics, or silent performance degradation. Load all HIGH entries before writing async Rust code.

## Entries

- [Blocking std::fs calls on Tokio runtime starve the executor](blocking-io-on-tokio.md): Path::exists(), metadata(), and read_dir() from std::fs block the async executor thread. Use tokio::fs or spawn_blocking instead. HIGH.
- [GUI-subsystem parent spawns visible console windows for every console child](gui-subsystem-console-child-window.md): A windows_subsystem="windows" binary has no console, so every console child (git, where, taskkill) pops a new console window; on a poll loop it flashes and steals keyboard focus. Set CREATE_NO_WINDOW (0x0800_0000). HIGH.
- [reqwest multipart streams the body and masks connect/timeout errors as body errors](reqwest-multipart-masks-transport-errors.md): With the multipart feature, connect/timeout failures surface as opaque body errors with is_connect()/is_timeout() both false, breaking retry taxonomies; hand-assemble a buffered multipart body instead. HIGH.
- [reqwest 0.13 renamed the 0.12 TLS umbrella features](reqwest-013-tls-feature-rename.md): rustls-tls-webpki-roots no longer exists; use "rustls" + "webpki-roots" (or "rustls-native-certs"). Cargo resolution fails with a missing-feature error. MEDIUM.
- [cargo update silently holds a crate back when the newer version drops a required feature](cargo-update-silent-holdback-on-feature-removal.md): Feature removals can ship in patch releases (reqwest dropped webpki-roots between 0.13.1 and 0.13.4); cargo update prints "Locking 0 packages" and quietly keeps the old version, so the project looks current while pinned. Probe "Unchanged X (available: Y)" lines with --precise to surface the real blocker. HIGH.
- [rubato 4.0 removed the FftFixed/SincFixed types; whole-clip resampling must use process_all](rubato-4-whole-clip-process-all.md): The FftFixedIn/SincFixedIn family is gone (use Fft + FixedSync + audioadapter buffers), and resampling a whole clip with one oversized process() call silently leaves the FFT startup delay in: leading silence, truncated tail. process_all trims it and returns exactly ceil(len * ratio) frames. HIGH.
- [Phonetic code equality alone must never trigger a text replacement](phonetic-code-equality-needs-confirm-guard.md): Double Metaphone collides common words with proper nouns ("matter" and "modero" both encode to MTR in rphonetic 3.0.6), so replacement needs a string-similarity confirm guard (e.g. strsim jaro_winkler >= 0.85) plus exact-only gating for words of <= 3 chars or containing digits. HIGH.
- [libsqlite3-sys 0.38.x requires Rust 1.95+ but declares no rust-version](libsqlite3-sys-msrv-cfg-select.md): rusqlite 0.40.1 pins it exactly; its build script uses cfg_select!, so an older toolchain fails with an opaque E0658 in a vendored build script instead of an MSRV error. Update the toolchain and declare rust-version = "1.97". HIGH.
- [eframe 0.34 replaced App::update with logic + ui; 0.35 deleted the old names and unified the panels](eframe-034-app-trait-split.md): ui() now takes a root &mut egui::Ui (no margin/background; wrap in CentralPanel), logic(ctx) is the event-drain slot that also runs while hidden on request_repaint; SidePanel/TopBottomPanel became egui::Panel and show_inside became show. Pre-0.34 examples do not compile. MEDIUM.
- [egui companion crates habitually lag core minor releases](egui-companion-crate-lag.md): Verified 2026-07-16: egui-phosphor pins ^0.34 while egui is 0.35 (notify 0.34, catppuccin 0.33, modal 0.30). Prefer built-ins (egui::Modal, animate_value_with_time, hand-rolled Visuals); for icon fonts, vendor the TTF + generated codepoint constants from the same crate package. MEDIUM.
- [Startup set_theme(System) silently clobbers the user's persisted theme preference](eframe-set-theme-clobbers-persisted-preference.md): eframe's persistence restores the user's ThemePreference before the app constructor runs, so a theme-setup function ending in set_theme(ThemePreference::System) resets it every launch; the Light/Dark choice quietly stops sticking. Re-apply ctx.options(|o| o.theme_preference) instead. HIGH.
- [CollapsingHeader::open(Some(..)) every frame locks the header; pass it for one frame to latch](egui-collapsingheader-controlled-open-latch.md): Some(state) on every frame makes the header fully controlled and user clicks look broken; default_open only applies before any stored state exists. For "expand programmatically, user stays in charge": Some(true) for exactly one frame, then None. MEDIUM.
- [ScrollArea::show_rows assumes uniform row heights; heterogeneous lists break the scroll math](egui-show-rows-uniform-height.md): show_rows virtualizes by pure row_height arithmetic, so group headers, expandable rows, or any variable-height element silently desynchronize the scrollbar and row positions; bound the rendered set (windowed queries + "Show more") or hand-roll show_viewport heights instead. MEDIUM.
- [A JoinHandle joined in Drop deadlocks when a later-dropped field still holds a sender to the worker](join-on-drop-sender-field-order.md): recv() loops end only when every Sender clone drops, and struct fields drop in declaration order; declare every sender-holding subsystem (including ones owning forwarding threads) before the handle that joins, or the app hangs on exit with no error. HIGH.
- [A mean-RMS silence gate over a padded audio window is utterance-length dependent](mean-rms-gate-length-dependent.md): Pre-roll/tail padding dilutes a mean, so the gate passes only if speech_rms * sqrt(speech_fraction) >= threshold and the effective threshold RISES as utterances shorten; short commands get dropped silently while identical-level long sentences pass. Gate on the loudest ~100 ms window instead, OR'd with a noise-floor-relative test. HIGH.
- [cargo check does not type-check test code, so a breaking rename looks clean](cargo-check-skips-test-targets.md): cargo check/clippy default to lib+bins; #[cfg(test)] modules and tests/ are skipped, so a renamed enum variant leaves tests broken while the check reports clean. Fatal for crates that cannot link locally, where cargo test is unavailable. Use --all-targets everywhere. MEDIUM.
- [egui's monitor_size cannot position a window: no monitor origin, no per-monitor DPI](egui-viewport-position-monitor-size.md): monitor_size is a size alone, so a position computed from it assumes the current monitor starts at (0,0) and shares the primary's DPI; ViewportBuilder::with_position is virtual-desktop coordinates converted with a scale factor winit guesses before the window has a monitor. On multi-monitor/mixed-DPI the window is created and painted every frame at coordinates no monitor covers -- silent, and it presents as a phantom regression when eframe persistence restores the parent onto a different monitor. Place it from real OS geometry (Win32 GetMonitorInfoW rcWork + GetDpiForMonitor) via ViewportCommand::OuterPosition inside the child viewport's own frame. HIGH.
- [winit's with_decorations(false) keeps WS_CAPTION, so a window region makes Windows paint caption buttons](winit-undecorated-window-keeps-caption-styles.md): winit never removes WS_CAPTION|WS_BORDER|WS_SYSMENU ("required styles ... like aero snap"); it hides the frame only via a WM_NCCALCSIZE override that bails to DefWindowProc when wParam is FALSE. SetWindowRgn (the normal way to shape a borderless window) takes it off DWM's frame path and Windows draws the caption it never removed -- maximise/close buttons over your own rendering, plus the overlay becomes a window the user can close. Strip the styles to WS_POPUP with SetWindowLongPtrW + SWP_FRAMECHANGED|SWP_NOACTIVATE BEFORE applying the region. HIGH.
- [An egui deferred viewport is torn down only by a PARENT pass, so a self-repainting child outlives its owner](egui-deferred-viewport-parent-pass-teardown.md): egui prunes an unregistered viewport from the PARENT's viewport_output, but inside a child callback ctx.request_repaint_after() targets that child -- so the usual 60 fps animation line keeps the child alive while the parent sleeps and never re-runs the check that would retire it. Miss one parent wake-up and an always-on-top borderless window is stranded on the desktop with no owner and often no way to close it; worst in a tray app whose hidden root only repaints on demand. Also request_repaint_after_for(.., ViewportId::ROOT) from the child. (From a worker thread the stack is empty, so plain request_repaint() correctly targets ROOT.) HIGH.
- [Edition 2021 captures closure fields, so destructuring a Send newtype in the closure defeats the wrapper](closure-field-capture-defeats-send-wrapper.md): The standard `struct SendHandle(HANDLE); unsafe impl Send` trick silently does nothing if the closure body destructures it (`let SendHandle(h) = w`), because disjoint capture takes the bare non-Send field; the error names the inner type and the wrapper above it looks correct. Read through a method (or re-let the binding) so the whole struct is captured. Platform-gated handles make it worse: a Linux/macOS dev loop compiles none of it and reports clean until the Windows release build. MEDIUM.
- [Sibling ScrollAreas built on the same parent Ui silently share one scroll offset](egui-scrollarea-shared-id-salt.md): A ScrollArea's id is its parent Ui's id plus a salt that defaults to the literal "scroll_area" -- not the widget auto-id counter -- so every scroll area built on one parent Ui (the usual "centered content column + match on page" shell) reads and writes a single stored offset and a page switch lands scrolled where the previous page was. check_for_id_clash never fires because only one branch renders per frame, and the offset is clamped to content height, so it presents as a layout bug in innocent page code. Give every ScrollArea an explicit .id_salt(). MEDIUM.
- [A self-animating child viewport starves its parent of WM_PAINT, so the parent stops running passes](egui-child-viewport-starves-parent-wm-paint.md): On Windows a visible window repaints only when the OS delivers WM_PAINT -- the lowest-priority message, generated only when the queue is empty -- so an eframe deferred viewport animating at 60 fps with a vsync-blocking swap_buffers can starve its parent of paints for seconds. App::logic runs only in a parent pass, so events go undrained, the tray freezes, and the child viewport is never retired. It inverts the usual symptom (fine minimized or in the tray, broken with the window OPEN) because eframe paints hidden/minimized windows directly from its own loop, bypassing the queue. Worse, the obvious kick is a no-op: winit's Window::request_redraw IS RedrawWindow(RDW_INTERNALPAINT). Do not make the child's visibility depend on a parent pass -- publish "should I be up" as shared state (Arc<AtomicBool>) and have the child hide ITSELF with ViewportCommand::Visible(false) from its own pass, which also ends the repaint causing the starvation. HIGH.
